rules.name: migration-checks-01-dev-uat
rules.sql: WITH RECURSIVE price AS ( SELECT (SELECT min(u.underlying_id) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = :tenant) AS underlying_id UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT min(u.underlying_id) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = :tenant AND u.underlying_id > price.underlying_id) FROM price WHERE price.underlying_id IS NOT NULL ), req_trig(trigger_name) AS (VALUES ('deal_active_lots_table.trg_sync_latest_active_lot'), ('deal_active_lots_table.trg_latest_active_lot_history_truncate'), ('valuation_date_table.trg_latest_active_lot_valuation_date'), ('valuation_date_table.trg_latest_active_lot_valuation_truncate'), ('security_info_table.trg_populate_security_info_strikes'), ('cloned_security_info_table.trg_populate_cloned_security_info_strikes'), ('security_info_table.security_info_barrier_monitoring_aiu'), ('deal_ticket_table.trg_deal_ticket_fxoption_maturity_date_ains'), ('deal_ticket_table.trg_deal_ticket_fxoption_maturity_date_aupd'), ('recon_settle_snapshot.trg_sync_market_impact_pnl_insert'), ('subportfolio_product_mapping_table.subportfolio_product_mapping_bo_sync')), c AS ( SELECT 'I09' AS issue, 'client_sub_account has rows' AS check_name, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.client_sub_account WHERE tenant_id = :tenant) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END::bigint AS bad UNION ALL SELECT 'I07', 'client_information_table: client_business_unit filled (rows exist but none filled = 1)', CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.client_information_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.client_information_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND client_business_unit IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END UNION ALL SELECT 'I11', 'product_master_table rows with status NULL (about 30 views filter status = Active)', (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.product_master_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND status IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT 'I14', 'valuation_date_table rows with NULL business_unit', (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT 'I15', 'status_table client statement status rows (tablename client_statement_cache_table_<tenant>_<bu>) with NULL business_unit; legacy rows loaded with NULL BU by load_12 are not read with a BU filter', (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.status_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit IS NULL AND tablename LIKE 'client_statement_cache_table_' || :tenant || '_%') UNION ALL SELECT 'I16', 'required triggers missing in the schema (count of the 11 in the list)', (SELECT count(*) FROM req_trig r WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class k ON k.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = k.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND k.relname || '.' || t.tgname = r.trigger_name)) UNION ALL SELECT 'I16', 'user triggers that are disabled', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class k ON k.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = k.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgenabled = 'D') UNION ALL SELECT 'I17', 'security_info_table: vol 1 only, strike set, strike1 NULL (strike function did not run)', (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.security_info_table WHERE vol1_id IS NOT NULL AND vol2_id IS NULL AND strike IS NOT NULL AND strike1 IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT 'I18', 'business_unit not UPPER in valuation_date_table, status_table, client_master_data, business_group_table', (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit <> upper(business_unit)) + (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.status_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit <> upper(business_unit)) + (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.client_master_data WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit <> upper(business_unit)) + (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.business_group_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit <> upper(business_unit)) UNION ALL SELECT 'I36', 'business_group_table group_code or group_name not UPPER', (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.business_group_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND (group_code <> upper(group_code) OR group_name <> upper(group_name))) UNION ALL SELECT 'I04', 'business units in valuation_date_table with no row in security_info_table (BUs listed in empty_bus are skipped)', (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT business_unit FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit IS NOT NULL AND business_unit <> ALL (string_to_array(:empty_bus, ','))) v WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.security_info_table s WHERE s.business_unit = v.business_unit)) UNION ALL SELECT 'I20', 'latest_active_lot is empty', CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.latest_active_lot WHERE tenant_id = :tenant) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END UNION ALL SELECT 'I20', 'business units in valuation_date_table with no latest_active_lot row (a BU with no deals also counts; BUs in empty_bus are skipped)', (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT business_unit FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit IS NOT NULL AND business_unit <> ALL (string_to_array(:empty_bus, ','))) v WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.latest_active_lot l WHERE l.tenant_id = :tenant AND l.business_unit = v.business_unit)) UNION ALL SELECT 'I22', 'latest_active_lot.active_lots is not double precision', (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'opera' AND table_name = 'latest_active_lot' AND column_name = 'active_lots' AND data_type <> 'double precision') UNION ALL SELECT 'I23', 'currency_spot_mapping_table.spot letter case differs from the price table', (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table m JOIN price p ON lower(p.underlying_id) = lower(m.spot) AND p.underlying_id <> m.spot WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant) UNION ALL SELECT 'I23', 'product_master_table.curr_mult_factor letter case differs from the price table', (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.product_master_table m JOIN price p ON lower(p.underlying_id) = lower(m.curr_mult_factor) AND p.underlying_id <> m.curr_mult_factor WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant) UNION ALL SELECT 'I24', 'client_master_data.client_status in capitals (COMPLETED, PENDING)', (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.client_master_data WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND client_status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PENDING')) UNION ALL SELECT 'I25', 'client names or parents containing a question mark (encoding damage; a real question mark also counts)', (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.client_master_data WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND (client_name LIKE '%?%' OR counterparty_parent LIKE '%?%')) UNION ALL SELECT 'I27', 'recon_position_classification_input: RBA or RBC has no rows (recon fails: no effective Price/Hedge mapping)', (SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES ('RBA'), ('RBC')) b(bu) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.recon_position_classification_input r WHERE r.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(r.business_unit) = b.bu)) UNION ALL SELECT 'I28', 'correl_product_mapping has no CFS rows (WP Greeks 0, OUAT-178)', CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.correl_product_mapping WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END UNION ALL SELECT 'I29', 'helper_var_mult_factor_view is empty (Combined VAR delta and gamma 0, XOGA-713)', CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END UNION ALL SELECT 'I32', 'functions in the schema that still name opera_migration (body or search_path)', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND p.prokind IN ('f', 'p') AND (pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) ILIKE '%opera_migration%' OR coalesce(array_to_string(p.proconfig, ','), '') ILIKE '%opera_migration%')) UNION ALL SELECT 'I32', 'views in the schema that still name opera_migration', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class k JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = k.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND k.relkind IN ('v', 'm') AND pg_get_viewdef(k.oid) ILIKE '%opera_migration%') ) SELECT issue, check_name, bad, CASE WHEN bad = 0 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS verdict FROM c ORDER BY issue, check_name
